propositions: transition_close.py at 803 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap, causing the module-size gate to fail and block all Gerrit changes with Verified -1.

The completion-verification precheck cluster (_completion_precheck, _has_live_replacement_link, _is_live_ticket, _referencing_commit_exists, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) forms a self-contained call-graph seam that can be extracted without breaking dependencies.

Extracting the precheck cluster into a new transition_close_precheck.py module and re-importing it in transition_close.py preserves monkeypatch interception and direct module-attribute calls in existing tests through dynamic global lookup.
Post-split sizes must land transition_close.py in the 200-500 LOC band and transition_close_precheck.py above the 100-LOC floor, with neither file exceeding 800 LOC.
All existing close/completion test suites must pass without assertion changes after the move, verified by a new seam test that asserts the binding contract between the two modules.
